#!/usr/bin/env bash
# docs/concepts/working-in-a-team.md, driven in the order the page shows it
# (cc, 2026-09-24, for the 3.2.1 doc audit; extends ST0078's P4 drive). Two
# people, one bare origin standing in for the GitHub repository, a third clone
# standing in for GitHub's merge buttons, an isolated HOME. intentd runs only
# in section 5.
#
# Usage: working-in-a-team-drive.sh <SHORT-scratch-dir> <dir-holding-intent-and-intentd> <dir-holding-a-3.0.x-pair>
# The scratch dir must be short: intentd's socket path is capped at 104 bytes.
# The third pair is one built before events travelled (the published v3.0.3
# release binaries serve); section 12 makes a project with it.
set -u
S="$1"; BIN="$2"; OLD="$3"
rm -rf "$S"; mkdir -p "$S/home" "$S/run"
export PATH="$BIN:$PATH"
export HOME="$S/home" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$S/home/.config" XDG_DATA_HOME="$S/home/.local/share" XDG_STATE_HOME="$S/home/.local/state" XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$S/run"
mkdir -p "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME" "$XDG_DATA_HOME" "$XDG_STATE_HOME"; unset CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID
trap 'intent daemon stop >/dev/null 2>&1' EXIT
h() { printf '\n===== %s\n' "$*"; }
run() { printf '$ %s\n' "$*"; "$@" 2>&1; printf '  rc=%s\n' "$?"; }
# `intent st new`, printed like run(), leaving the minted id in $ID.
mint() { local out rc; printf '$ intent st new %s\n' "$1"; out=$(intent st new "$1" 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n  rc=%s\n' "$out" "$rc"; ID=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n 's/^created: //p'); }
commit() { git add -A && git commit -q -m "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "committed: $1" || { echo "COMMIT REFUSED: $1"; git add -A; git commit -m "$1" 2>&1 | tail -12; }; }
printf 'pair: %s\n' "$(command -v intent)"; run intent --version

git init -q --bare -b main "$S/origin.git"

h "1 alice: start the project and put it on the forge"
git clone -q "$S/origin.git" "$S/alice" 2>/dev/null && cd "$S/alice" && git config user.name Alice && git config user.email alice@example.com
run intent init Team
run grep -n -E '^intent/(\.cache|\.backup)' .gitignore
run intent bootstrap
run intent claude upgrade --apply --skip-settings
commit "intent init"; run git push -q -u origin main

h "2 bob: clone it, then once per machine and once per clone"
git clone -q "$S/origin.git" "$S/bob" && cd "$S/bob" && git config user.name Bob && git config user.email bob@example.com
run intent bootstrap
run intent claude upgrade --apply --skip-settings
run ls .git/hooks
run intent st list --status all

h "3 alice: a thread on a branch, reviewed as a pull request, merged with a merge commit"
cd "$S/alice"; run git switch -c alice/onboarding
mint "Onboarding guide"; ONBOARD=$ID
run intent st start "$ONBOARD"; run intent wp new "$ONBOARD" "Write the guide"
run git status --short
commit "$ONBOARD: onboarding guide, WP-01"; run git push -q -u origin alice/onboarding
run git diff --stat main...alice/onboarding
run git switch -q main; run git status --short
run git merge -q --no-ff alice/onboarding -m "Merge alice/onboarding"; run git push -q origin main

h "4 alice: a second pull request, squash-merged and then rebase-merged on the forge"
cd "$S/alice"; run git switch -q -c alice/checklist
mint "Release checklist"; RELEASE=$ID; commit "$RELEASE: release checklist"
run intent wp new "$RELEASE" "Draft the checklist"; commit "$RELEASE: WP-01"
run git push -q -u origin alice/checklist
git clone -q "$S/origin.git" "$S/forge" && cd "$S/forge" && git config user.name Forge && git config user.email forge@example.com
printf '(the forge: a clone with no Intent hooks, standing in for the squash button)\n'
run git merge --squash origin/alice/checklist; run git commit -q -m "Release checklist (#2)"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/alice"; run git switch -q main; run git pull -q; run intent st list --status all; run git branch -q -D alice/checklist
run git switch -q -c alice/triage
mint "Triage rota"; ROTA=$ID; commit "$ROTA: triage rota"; run git push -q -u origin alice/triage
cd "$S/forge"; run git fetch -q origin
printf '(the forge again, standing in for the rebase button)\n'
run git switch -q -c rebased origin/alice/triage; run git rebase -q main; run git switch -q main; run git merge -q --ff-only rebased; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/alice"; run git switch -q main; run git pull -q; run git branch -q -D alice/triage

h "5 bob: pull, and the store follows"
cd "$S/bob"; run git pull -q
run intent st list --status all; run intent st show "$RELEASE"
run intent set "$ONBOARD" context "Bob's notes for the guide"; commit "$ONBOARD: context"
cd "$S/alice"; run intent issues add "Login fails on Safari"; commit "an issue"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/bob"; run git pull --rebase -q; run git log --oneline -3; run git push -q origin main
run intent daemon start
cd "$S/alice"; run git pull -q; mint "Security review"; commit "security review"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/bob"; run git pull -q; run intent st list --status all; run intent sync
run intent daemon stop

h "6 the hooks do not see every way a tree moves"
cd "$S/alice"; run git pull -q
run intent set "$RELEASE" title "Release checklist, v2"; commit "$RELEASE retitled"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/bob"; run git fetch -q origin; run git reset -q --hard origin/main
run intent doctor
run intent set "$RELEASE" context "Requested by support; retitled upstream"
run git diff --stat
run git checkout -- .
run intent sync --apply
run intent set "$RELEASE" context "Requested by support; retitled upstream"
run git diff --stat
commit "$RELEASE context"; run git push -q origin main

h "7 both mint one thread id: renumber before the merge"
cd "$S/alice"; run git pull -q; mint "Alice's next"; commit "alice: $ID"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/bob"; mint "Bob's next"; MINE=$ID; commit "bob: $MINE"
run git pull --no-rebase -q; run git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U; run git merge --abort
FREE=$(printf 'ST%04d' $(( 10#${MINE#ST} + 1 )))
run intent st renumber "$MINE" "$FREE"
commit "renumber my $MINE to $FREE"
run git pull --no-rebase -q; run git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
run intent sync --apply --yes
run git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
commit "merge main: Alice's $MINE, mine is $FREE"; run git push -q origin main
run intent st list --status all; run intent doctor

h "7b both mint one thread id again: one command repairs it mid-merge"
cd "$S/alice"; run git pull -q; mint "Alice's other"; commit "alice: $ID"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/bob"; mint "Bob's other"; commit "bob: $ID"
run git pull --no-rebase -q; run git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
run intent sync
run intent sync --apply
run intent sync --apply --yes
run git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
commit "merge main: the one command renumbered mine"; run git push -q origin main
run intent st list --status all; run intent doctor

h "7c both add an issue: the same command"
cd "$S/alice"; run git pull -q; run intent issues add "Search misses archived threads"; commit "alice: an issue"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/bob"; run intent issues add "Install page has a typo"; commit "bob: an issue"
run git pull --no-rebase -q; run git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
run intent sync --apply --yes
commit "merge main: my issue renumbered"; run git push -q origin main
run intent issues list

h "7d both add a work package to one thread: redo yours after the pull"
cd "$S/alice"; run git pull -q; run intent wp new "$ONBOARD" "Record a walkthrough"; commit "alice: a WP"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/bob"; run intent wp new "$ONBOARD" "Add screenshots"; commit "bob: a WP"
run git pull --no-rebase -q; run git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
run intent sync
run git merge --abort
run git reset -q --hard origin/main
run intent sync --apply
run intent wp new "$ONBOARD" "Add screenshots"
commit "bob: a WP, after the pull"; run git push -q origin main
run intent wp list "$ONBOARD"

h "8 both edit one thread"
cd "$S/alice"; run git pull -q
run intent set "$RELEASE" objective "Bring a new engineer to a first merged PR in a day"; commit "$RELEASE objective"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/bob"; run intent set "$RELEASE" context "Requested by support after three onboarding escalations"; commit "$RELEASE context, again"
run git pull --no-rebase -q; run git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
run grep -n -E '^(<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>)|"objective"|"context"' "intent/.canon/st/$RELEASE.json"
run intent sync
python3 - "$RELEASE" <<'PY'
import re, sys
p="intent/.canon/st/%s.json" % sys.argv[1]; t=open(p).read()
def keep_both(m):
  # Each side changed one field and left the other as it found it, so a field
  # takes the other side's line only where this side's is still empty.
  ours, theirs = m.group(1).splitlines(), m.group(2).splitlines()
  field = lambda line: line.strip().split(":")[0]
  out = []
  for line in ours:
    if line.strip().endswith('"",'):
      line = next((t for t in theirs if field(t) == field(line)), line)
    out.append(line)
  return "".join(l + "\n" for l in out)
t=re.sub(r"<<<<<<< [^\n]*\n(.*?)=======\n(.*?)>>>>>>> [^\n]*\n", keep_both, t, flags=re.S)
open(p,"w").write(t); print("(edited %s by hand: kept both fields)" % p)
PY
run git add "intent/.canon/st/$RELEASE.json"
run intent sync --apply --yes
run git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
commit "merge: both $RELEASE edits"; run git push -q origin main
run grep -n -E '"objective"|"context"' "intent/.canon/st/$RELEASE.json"; run intent doctor

h "9 commit the views with what they were rendered from"
cd "$S/bob"; run intent st start "$FREE"
python3 - "$FREE" <<'PY'
import re, sys
p="intent/st/%s/info.md" % sys.argv[1]; t=open(p).read()
t=re.sub(r"(## Objective\n\n)", r"\1Edited by hand and not synced. ", t, count=1)
open(p,"w").write(t); print("(edited %s's Objective by hand, no sync)" % p)
PY
commit "unsynced objective edit"
run git reset -q
run intent sync --to-disk
commit "start $FREE"; run git push -q origin main

h "10 history travels"
cd "$S/alice"; run git pull -q
run intent events --subject "$RELEASE"
cd "$S/bob"; run intent events --subject "$RELEASE"

h "11 a project made before events travelled: intent upgrade backfills it"
mkdir -p "$S/carol" && cd "$S/carol" && git init -q -b main && git config user.name Carol && git config user.email carol@example.com
printf '(with the older pair: %s)\n' "$("$OLD/intent" --version)"
PATH="$OLD:$PATH" intent init Legacy >/dev/null 2>&1; PATH="$OLD:$PATH" intent st new "Before events travelled" >/dev/null 2>&1; PATH="$OLD:$PATH" intent st start ST0001 >/dev/null 2>&1
git add -A && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null commit -q -m "legacy project" && echo "committed: legacy project"
printf '(with the pair under test from here)\n'
run git ls-files intent/.cache
run intent upgrade
run git rm -q --cached intent/.cache/intent.db
run git status --short --untracked-files=all
commit "intent upgrade"
run intent upgrade
run git status --short --untracked-files=all
run git ls-files intent/.cache

h "12 a canon file written by a newer Intent"
cd "$S/bob"; run git pull -q; run git status --short
run grep -n '"schema"' "intent/.canon/st/$RELEASE.json"
sed -i.bak 's#"schema": "intent/thread@3.0"#"schema": "intent/thread@9.0"#' "intent/.canon/st/$RELEASE.json" && rm -f "intent/.canon/st/$RELEASE.json.bak"
printf '(rewrote %s schema to intent/thread@9.0, a version this binary does not know)\n' "intent/.canon/st/$RELEASE.json"
run grep -n '"schema"' "intent/.canon/st/$RELEASE.json"
run intent sync --apply
run intent st show "$RELEASE"
run intent doctor
run git checkout -- "intent/.canon/st/$RELEASE.json"
run intent sync --apply
run git status --short

h "13 the whiteboard across clones"
cd "$S/alice"; run git pull -q
run intent wb register al --name "Alice's agent" --role worker
run intent wb add todo "Draft the onboarding guide" --node al
run git status --short --untracked-files=all
commit "wb: al"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/bob"; run git pull -q
run intent wb status
run intent sync --to-store
run intent wb register bo --name "Bob's agent" --role worker
run intent wb ask al "Can I take the release checklist?" --node bo
commit "wb: bo"; run git push -q origin main
cd "$S/alice"; run git pull -q
run intent sync --to-store
run intent wb pickup --node al

h "14 the CI job, run by hand on a fresh clone of the merge result"
git clone -q "$S/origin.git" "$S/ci" && cd "$S/ci"
run intent doctor
